description: Three thematically curated Mordheim scenario choices for every attacker-quest / defender-quest matchup. The campaign generator shuffles each cell's choices at campaign creation and avoids repeating a scenario within a campaign when possible.

hidden-treasure.title: Hidden Treasure
hidden-treasure.hook: Search ruined cellars for a chest before a rival warband carries it away.

haunted-treasure.title: Haunted Treasure
haunted-treasure.hook: Find the chest in a ruined house while a Banshee guards the hoard.

wyrdstone-hunt.title: Wyrdstone Hunt
wyrdstone-hunt.hook: Both bands sweep a ruined warehouse for scattered wyrdstone.

finders-keepers.title: Finders Keepers
finders-keepers.hook: Race through the outskirts to recover a stash and escape with it.

item-lost.title: The Item Lost
item-lost.hook: A wand lies in the street; whichever band extracts it controls the prize.

gift-of-truthsayers.title: Gift of the Truthsayers
gift-of-truthsayers.hook: A magical artefact lies on a fenland crag as the bog turns hostile.

ogham-stones.title: The Ogham Stones
ogham-stones.hook: Rival warbands contest ancient stones that magnify a wizard's power.

defend-the-find.title: Defend the Find
defend-the-find.hook: Attackers storm a building where defenders have secured a cache.

defend-the-tomb.title: Defend the Tomb
defend-the-tomb.hook: A treasure carrier tries to escape a burial chamber before rivals seize the chest.

tomb-raid.title: Tomb Raid
tomb-raid.hook: Both bands race through a tomb to seize and extract its chest.

breakthrough.title: Breakthrough
breakthrough.hook: One band attempts to force a passage across the defender's line.

through-black-fire-pass.title: Through Black Fire Pass
through-black-fire-pass.hook: An ambush on a mountain trade route becomes a race to escape the pass.

great-library.title: The Great Library
great-library.hook: Rival scholars fight over scattered tomes in the charred library.

wizards-tower.title: The Wizard's Tower
wizards-tower.hook: Ambushers pursue treasure-laden heroes as they flee the wizard's tower.

lost-temple-slann.title: Lost Temple of the Slann
lost-temple-slann.hook: A forgotten temple shelters arcane relics and its defending force.

watchtower.title: The Watchtower
watchtower.hook: Raiders try to silence a signal while the border garrison holds its tower.

occupy.title: Occupy
occupy.hook: Both warbands fight to secure the buildings that command the district.

defend-the-village.title: Defend the Village!
defend-the-village.hook: One warband protects villagers against a raiding force.

defend-the-oasis.title: Defend the Oasis
defend-the-oasis.hook: Attackers press a vital well while defenders strive to hold it.

surprise-attack.title: Surprise Attack
surprise-attack.hook: A scattered patrol must rally against a sudden attack.

encampment-raid.title: Encampment Raid
encampment-raid.hook: Raiders assault a fortified warband camp to seize its stores.

protect-the-prince.title: Protect the Prince
protect-the-prince.hook: Bodyguards escort a prince across the field while raiders hunt him.

river-watch.title: River Watch
river-watch.hook: Smugglers try to cross the river and escape over the guarded north bank.

street-fight.title: Street Fight
street-fight.hook: Rival scouts fight for passage down a street with no retreat.

rescue.title: Rescue
rescue.hook: Attackers break into a hideout to free a captured warrior.

the-gauntlet.title: The Gauntlet
the-gauntlet.hook: Warbands race through trapped corridors toward an ancient treasure.
